integrity.description: The agent used the TiddlyWiki web interface rather than executing shell commands to modify the underlying files.
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see mouse movements, clicks on wiki buttons, and browser-based interactions rather than a terminal window executing 'rm' or 'sed' commands.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply delete the entire wiki database or use a script to wipe the directory.
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see individual tiddlers being handled or the wiki interface remaining functional throughout the process.

integrity.description: The agent navigated the wiki to find the tags rather than guessing URLs or using pre-known direct links not visible in the UI.
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the agent clicking on the 'Tags' tab or using the search bar within the wiki UI.
